targetArchitecture.result: Selected one dedicated SQL Authority Worker owning DuckDB-Wasm, the persistent OPFS database, successful-cycle writes, active SQL scheduling and query execution. Recorder remains provider/validation owner; Viewer windows are read-only clients without direct authoritative DB handles.
targetArchitecture.baseline: single-threaded DuckDB-Wasm; coi threading is optional future optimization only
